messages.subject: R811 report complete
messages.body: Read the required artifact retention guidance and research index metadata, then produced the 1,799-word report at bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/research-round811-v1.txt (SHA256 11b00b86aef965f857f2d863fe74256275a00aa696602786f074510c6072e845). It records the pinned TLA and LLVM contracts, descriptor versus allocation extents, three Strata shape mappings, ragged-tail and short-K prefetch guards, and unresolved BMG store/prefetch edge semantics. No implementation, build, test, GPU/runtime query, profiling, Git operation, cleanup, or other edit was performed; runtime and performance validation and the listed hardware boundary cases remain for a future owner.
